The '''1948–49 [[Eliteserien|Hovedserien]]''' was the 5th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Following are the results of the 1948–49 Norwegian Main League season. At the top of the [[Norwegian football league system]], it was [[Norway]]'s top-tier league for [[association football]] clubs.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Fredrikstad FK]] won the championship.
